note: No queryable ArcGIS or WFS zoning district layer found for Holt County, MO after searching ArcGIS Hub/Online and the web. The county does not publish countywide zoning; the county GIS portal lists parcels only. Mound City's code says its district boundaries follow an Official Zoning Map, but no GIS service for it was found; Oregon, Forest City and Craig showed none either. Only a parcel source (Regrid, commercial) carries zoning, and it is not an official public service.
